reviews.title: Enjoyable content, but,
reviews.text: This app provides enjoyable content, especially directors commentary. However, the ads that are served up in the free version are sleazy at best. Also there is no reason for this app to require having location services turned on all the time. While Using the app, I can understand, all the time there’s no reason.  Makes me question what data they’re collecting and what are they using it for?

reviews.title: Connection issues
reviews.text: In the last two or three times I’ve gone to the movies, the app hasn’t been able to connect to my phone at all. I’m basically paying for a service I can’t even use. They really need to upgrade this app because it’s not working properly.

reviews.title: Ads are Awful and UI is clunky
reviews.text: This is a great concept for an app but exected very poorly. The apps Ui feels like it was created in the early 2010s and never updated. Also the ads as soon as you open the app often glitch and cause the app to be unusable unless restarted. They also advertise very predatorial ads such as “your phone has been hacked”which is a big red flag. The fact that you have to allow the app to have your location at all times instead of just when you’re using it is very sketchy.

reviews.title: Tried to use twice, a BIG disappointment
reviews.text:
The first time I tried to use the app, it was for the movie The Devil Wears Prada 2. I wanted to use the English hearing impaired, but the only two choices were Spanish and French Canadian. Why??
I tried to use it again today at Regal Cinema for Project Hail Mary, but it would not let me choose my movie time. I went to the 2:50 PM show. The previous movie time showed in gray, but it would not let me choose the 2:50 PM show.  When I pulled up the program just now, at 9:35 PM, it now has the 2:50 PM showing selected. So far, this app has been a big disappointment.

reviews.title: Terrible disappointed
reviews.text:
"I am beyond frustrated with this app. I’ve used it once before and actually recommended it to many people, but today was a total disaster. I went to see 'Mother Mary' at the Secaucus, NJ cinema, and the app simply failed. It couldn't find the movie, the location sync is terrible, and the interface is unnecessarily complicated.
I feel embarrassed that I suggested this to others. For a company that is supposed to be 'growing' and capturing new users, they make it nearly impossible to actually get the service they promise. It should be simple: you arrive, you sync, and you listen. Instead, it’s a headache. I’m very disillusioned and won't be recommending this again until they fix their buggy system."

reviews.title: Great Idea, Terrible Implementation
reviews.text: So I tried this for a director commentary sync up and it was going great. The app was overly hard to get setup, filled with ads, including full page ads to other apps, and I am not paying a monthly subscription to it since I only occasionally see movies. I’d rather pay per download/file. Also the geo location was annoying.  It would not accept “only while using” and had to be set to “always”. You don’t need my always location except to track me and sell my data. Instant delete for me.

reviews.title: Needs wifi
reviews.text:
Good concept, it doesn’t work.
Some theaters don’t have good cellphone reception, the app doesn’t work at all without data or WiFi. I feel robbed because I pay for the year membership so my mother could watch a movie with me, we downloaded the content for the movie we were going to watch one hour earlier, checked the app before going inside of the theater and everything was working fine until we got inside of the theatre and lost signal. What a waste of time and money
